capabilityDetail: 1 valid notebook note(s) submitted by the browser agent during a complete kane-cli run
objective: You are investigating an AI board-game planner. Read this whole page: how the game works, the per-effect summary, the prior valuation versus measured consequences, the raw trigger and placement histories, and the planner choices with their rejected alternatives. Work out WHY the AI uses Teleport and the east and west shoves the way it does. Consider at least two different explanations and look for rows that contradict them. Then, in the Investigation notebook form at the bottom, submit your best explanation, choose which part it involves, which measurement should change and in which direction, and write the alternative you considered. Submit at most 3 notes. Do not do anything else on the page.
